summary: Correct, minimal fix matching the real upstream resolution for #33856: broadening the FK attname check from `is None` to `in field.empty_values` so a non-numeric (CharField) PK assigned empty then saved gets copied onto the parent. No regression for numeric PKs since `0`/`False` are not in `empty_values`.

issues.description: Inline comment still says 'Use pk from related object if it has been saved after an assignment' — fine, but could note the empty-string/empty-value case now covered. Non-blocking nit.
